neighbours.label: the modifier in 'played a ___ role' (leadership, supporting, leading): a slot that predicts 'role'
fire: Throughout the merger she played a crucial leadership role in the talks.
The young actor won praise for his supporting role in the drama.
Germany took a leading role in drafting the new climate accord.
Volunteers played a vital role in rebuilding the flooded village.
He later assumed an advisory role on the board of the charity.
Women played a central role in the early labour movement.
The enzyme plays a key regulatory role in sugar metabolism.
Our neighbour took on a mentoring role for the new apprentices.
